verdict.rationale: Evidence pack only offers a generic marketing line about 'best-in-class layout tools, type tools, and more' with 'full control over how you design' (figma-docs-15), with no explicit mention of pen/path editing, boolean operations, or precise alignment tools. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pen tool/vector path editing, boolean union/subtract/intersect operations, and alignment/distribution tooling, plus any hands-on corroboration of these specific features.
